mil7.5.5:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, nakulassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.5.5:1.2: Yathā mahārāja nakulo uragam-upagacchanto bhesajjena kāyaṃ paribhāvetvā uragam-upagacchati gahetuṃ,
mil7.5.5:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena kodhāghātabahulaṃ kalaha-viggaha-vivāda-virodhābhi- bhūtaṃ lokam-upagacchantena mettābhesajjena mānasaṃ anulimpitabbaṃ.
mil7.5.5:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja nakulassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.5.5:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Sāriputtena dhammasenāpatinā:
